title: Central Maintenance System — Incomplete Data Load Session Reported
abstract: Fault isolation for an incomplete data load session reported at the maintenance terminal, covering the record format mismatch, the interrupted session case and the aircraft configuration alignment that closes it.

sections.purpose: This procedure isolates an incomplete or unreadable data load session reported by the central maintenance computer, and establishes what is actually loaded on the aircraft before any further loading is attempted.
sections.fault_description: The maintenance terminal reports the last load session as incomplete, or displays a record it cannot interpret. The condition follows a power interruption during loading, or the replacement of the configuration computer without the matching maintenance database. In the interrupted case the aircraft may be part loaded, which the report does not state directly; the operator sees an unreadable record rather than a warning that the configuration is unknown.
sections.isolation_procedure: 1. Do not start a corrective load before the evidence is recorded; the session overwrites it. 2. Read and record the configuration computer part number and the record format it reports. 3. Read and record the maintenance database part number. 4. If the formats disagree, this is a database standard mismatch and not a session fault; load the matching database and re-read the record. 5. If the formats agree and the last session is incomplete, list the items recorded as loaded and compare them against the intended load sheet. 6. Do the record format check in AMM-M-45-45-12-900-053-A. 7. Repeat any incomplete session in full, at the gate, with a stable ground power supply. 8. Align the aircraft configuration record with the exported load record and file the export. 9. If the record is still unreadable after the database and the session have both been corrected, replace the configuration computer.
sections.dispatch_note: An aircraft with an incomplete load session recorded must not be dispatched until the session has been repeated in full and the configuration record aligned. There is no minimum equipment list relief, because the condition is an unknown software configuration rather than an inoperative item.

type_data.fault_symptom: Last data load session reported incomplete or unreadable at the maintenance terminal

possible_causes.cause: Ground power interrupted during a load session
Configuration computer and maintenance database at different record standards
Portable loader disconnected before the session committed

dispatch.dispatch_condition: No relief. The session must be repeated in full and the configuration record aligned before dispatch.
